start: app.json version bumped to the new version on main; owner said 'release'

steps.action: Push a tag v<version> (for example v0.79.0)
user_sees: Run 'Build & Release (APK + AAB)' starts: phone-gate, build, update-proof, publish, play-upload
must_not: A release starts without the owner's 'release' word
The tag and app.json versions differ and the build goes on

user_sees: 'Require a passing phone test on this commit' green
must_not: The gate skipped on a tag

steps.action: build: typecheck, unit tests, release-check self-tests, watch unit tests, Gradle build, signing, same-signer check, release checks
user_sees: Files mettleup-v<version>.apk, .aab, -wear.apk, -wear.aab, .js.map, whats-new.json in artifact 'forgeai-build'
'AAB signer SHA-256: <one hash>'
must_not: A phone APK signed with a different key than the watch APK
A versionCode lower than the last release's

user_sees: The previous release installs, then this build updates it in place with the same firstInstallTime and the data marker intact
must_not: A build that needs an uninstall published

user_sees: GitHub Release 'MettleUp v<version>' with the four app files, the source map and whats-new.json
The AABs sent to Play's internal and closed tests
must_not: Anything sent to Play production
The Release published when update-proof failed

start: Actions tab, 'Build & Release (APK + AAB)', Run workflow on main (dry run)

user_sees: Version name '<version>-dryrun.<run number>'
build and update-proof run
must_not: A dry run publishing a Release
A dry run uploading to Play

user_sees: The gate step says loudly that it was skipped
must_not: skip_phone_gate taking effect on a tag push

start: Tag pushed but app.json still says the old version

steps.action: Push tag v<new> without bumping app.json
user_sees: 'Tag v<new> but apps/mobile/app.json says <old>. Bump app.json first.' and the build stops
must_not: Phones told to update to their own version
A Release published

steps.action: Push a tag on a commit whose phone test failed
user_sees: phone-gate red; nothing built
must_not: The build and publish running anyway

start: A tag for a version already released, or a re-run of a failed release

steps.action: Re-run the failed jobs of a release run after a fix-free retry
user_sees: Jobs re-run; publish only after build and update-proof both pass
must_not: A second Release for the same tag
Play getting the same versionCode twice

steps.action: Release checks find the versionCode not above the last release's
user_sees: The release checks fail and nothing is published
must_not: An older versionCode reaching phones

steps.action: Look at the public Release and the run log
user_sees: App files, source map and whats-new.json public on the Release
'Secrets present' style lines only; no key, password or keystore printed
must_not: The keystore or its password in the log
The keystore file left on the runner after the signing step

steps.action: Start the run on the tag push
user_sees: phone-gate runs phone_gate.py against qa-device.yml results for this commit or its parent
must_not: The run starting from a branch push

steps.action: Sign the APK with key rotation when ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 exists
user_sees: v1/v2 debug key, v3 release key with lineage; '16 KB zip alignment kept after signing.'
must_not: 'Signing broke the 16 KB zip alignment that Gradle's APK had.' ignored
The keystore left in $RUNNER_TEMP after the step

steps.action: Publish and hand the tag to play-upload.yml
user_sees: play-upload called with tag v<version>, dry_run false
must_not: play-upload running when publish failed

steps.action: Run with ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 set but ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS empty
user_sees: 'ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS is not set; refusing to ship a half-configured signature.' and the run fails
must_not: A half-signed APK uploaded

steps.action: Run with no release key at all
user_sees: Warning 'ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 is not set, so this build is signed with the PUBLIC debug key only'; release checks fail it when ALLOWED_CERT_SHA256 is set
must_not: A debug-only build published silently

start: update-proof fails after a successful build

steps.action: update-proof cannot update the previous release in place
user_sees: update-proof red; artifact 'update-proof' with evidence (kept 30 days)
must_not: publish or play-upload running
